text: Use monthly college budget worksheet to track income, expenses, and cash flow.
Enter monthly income and expenses to calculate total income and expenses.
Cash flow is auto-calculated, and cash flow chart is updated for you.
Select slider to get income, expenses, and cash flow charts for a month and year.
Additional instructions have been provided in column A in the worksheet. This text
has been intentionally hidden. To remove text, select column A, then select DELETE.
To unhide text, select column A, then change font color.
